title: NEXARA Personal Brain Architecture Design Contract V1
description: Architecture freeze contract for the NEXARA Personal Brain — a 10-component cognitive architecture that sits ABOVE the existing runtime as a design-only layer. This contract defines interfaces, data flows, component responsibilities, and integration boundaries. ZERO runtime modification. Implementation phase is explicitly deferred.
governed_by: NSEC V2.1 Article 1 (Fixed Engineering Loop), Article 4 (Best Direction First), Article 8 (Maximum Reachable Endpoint), Article 45 (Definition of Done)

design_principles.principle_1: Brain ABOVE Runtime — Brain components enrich and guide runtime execution; they do NOT replace, modify, or bypass the runtime pipeline.
design_principles.principle_2: Memory is the Foundation — All brain components operate over a unified memory fabric. No component stores its own separate truth.
design_principles.principle_3: Evidence-Backed Evolution — Every brain output (decision, inference, preference, pattern) must be traceable to evidence records.
design_principles.principle_4: Personal and Sovereign — The brain models ONE person's cognition. No multi-tenant, no shared models, no external training.
design_principles.principle_5: Incremental Activation — Components are activated progressively as their memory foundation matures. No big-bang brain boot.

architecture_overview.description: The NEXARA Personal Brain is a 10-component cognitive layer that sits between raw mission execution and the runtime pipeline. It adds reasoning, learning, reflection, and personalization capabilities that persist across missions.

layer_1_foundation.name: Memory Fabric
layer_1_foundation.description: The persistent substrate — all other components read from and write to this layer.

layer_2_cognition.name: Cognitive Engine
layer_2_cognition.description: Active processing — reasons over context, records decisions, learns from experience.

layer_3_meta.name: Meta-Cognition
layer_3_meta.description: Self-improvement — reflects on outcomes, models preferences, enhances mission execution.

layer_4_evolution.name: Evolution
layer_4_evolution.description: Long-term growth — pattern recognition, skill improvement, capability auto-registration.

1_memory_brain.name: Memory Brain
1_memory_brain.description: Unified memory fabric that consolidates all memory types (13 MemoryKind) across four layers (Working, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural). Provides the single source of truth for all brain components.
new_capabilities: Memory consolidation — merge related memories across layers
Memory decay — confidence-based staleness tracking
Memory retrieval ranking — relevance scoring with recency bias
Cross-layer query — transparent query across all four layers
Memory health metrics — coverage, freshness, consistency scores
1_memory_brain.integration: Wraps MemoryKernel + MemoryLayerManager. Does NOT modify memory.py. Adds consolidation and ranking on top of existing write/read paths.

2_personal_knowledge_graph.name: Personal Knowledge Graph
2_personal_knowledge_graph.description: Structured knowledge representation as entities + typed relations. Built on top of the semantic memory layer. Enables graph traversal, inference, and context expansion.
new_capabilities: Entity extraction — parse memory content into typed entities (Person, Concept, Tool, File, Decision, Pattern)
Relation inference — deduce implicit relations between entities (11 existing relation types + 6 new: PREFERS, AVOIDS, EVOLVED_FROM, CONTRADICTS, SUPPORTS, DEPENDS_ON)
Graph traversal — BFS/DFS over entity-relation graph for context expansion
Graph visualization — export to Graphviz/JSON for human review
Knowledge confidence — Bayesian confidence scoring per entity and relation
Graph pruning — remove low-confidence or superseded entities

interface.api: KnowledgeGraphAPI: extract_entities(), infer_relations(), traverse(), export_graph(), prune()

2_personal_knowledge_graph.integration: Reads from MemoryBrain semantic layer. Writes entity/relation metadata back to MemoryBrain as SEMANTIC/FACT memories. Does NOT duplicate memory storage.
2_personal_knowledge_graph.data_flow: Semantic memories → EntityExtractor → Entities + Relations → GraphStore (in-memory/SQLite) → TraversalEngine → ExpandedContext

3_long_term_memory.name: Long-term Memory
3_long_term_memory.description: Persistent, slow-changing memory for facts, preferences, rules, and project knowledge. Implements decay, reinforcement, and garbage collection.
3_long_term_memory.existing_foundation: MemoryKernel with SEMANTIC + PROCEDURAL layers, PREFERENCE/PROJECT_FACT/USER_FACT/SYSTEM_RULE kinds
new_capabilities: Memory decay model — exponential decay with half-life per memory kind
Reinforcement — access frequency boosts confidence, preventing decay
Long-term consolidation — promote frequently-accessed short-term memories to long-term
Supersession detection — flag outdated facts when new evidence contradicts
Garbage collection — auto-archive low-confidence, never-accessed memories
Provenance chain — track origin of every long-term memory back to evidence

interface.api: LongTermMemoryAPI: consolidate(), tick_decay(), reinforce(), garbage_collect(), provenance()

3_long_term_memory.integration: Operates over MemoryBrain's semantic + procedural layers. Adds decay/reinforcement metadata to existing records. Does NOT modify MemoryKernel write paths.
3_long_term_memory.data_flow: MemoryBrain records → DecayEngine (periodic) → ReinforceEngine (access-triggered) → ConsolidationEngine → Updated LTM store

4_decision_memory.name: Decision Memory
4_decision_memory.description: Records every significant decision with its full context: alternatives considered, rationale, evidence relied upon, outcome, and post-hoc evaluation. Enables future decisions to reference past decision patterns.
4_decision_memory.existing_foundation: MemoryKind.DECISION records, ApprovalEngine decisions, EvaluationEngine results
new_capabilities: Decision recording — structured capture of decision context, alternatives, rationale
Outcome linking — bind decision to mission outcome (success/failure/blocked)
Decision pattern mining — identify recurring decision types and their success rates
Decision recommendation — suggest approach based on similar past decisions
Decision audit trail — full trace from decision → evidence → outcome → evaluation
4_decision_memory.integration: Hooks into runtime stage processors (verify→evidence→eval) to capture decisions automatically. Writes to MemoryBrain as DECISION kind records.
4_decision_memory.data_flow: Runtime decision point → DecisionRecorder → DecisionRecord → MemoryBrain (DECISION) → PatternMiner → DecisionRecommendation

5_experience_memory.name: Experience Memory
5_experience_memory.description: Distills mission experiences into reusable lessons. Transforms raw failures and successes into structured experience records that inform future execution.
new_capabilities: Experience extraction — parse mission failure/success into structured lesson
Failure pattern clustering — group similar failures by FailureCode
Success pattern extraction — identify what worked and why
Lesson application — suggest applicable lessons for new mission context
Experience decay — lessons that never reapply lose confidence over time
Cross-mission learning — transfer lessons from one mission type to related types
5_experience_memory.integration: Hooks into evaluation stage. Reads EvaluationResult + FailureCode, writes FAILURE_EXPERIENCE + SKILL_IMPROVEMENT to MemoryBrain.
5_experience_memory.data_flow: EvaluationResult → ExperienceExtractor → ExperienceRecord → MemoryBrain (FAILURE_EXPERIENCE) → LessonRecommender → MissionIntelligence

6_reasoning_kernel.name: Reasoning Kernel
6_reasoning_kernel.description: Active inference engine that processes mission context + personal knowledge → reasoned decisions, plans, and predictions. The cognitive core of the brain.
6_reasoning_kernel.existing_foundation: MissionCompiler, ContractEngine, TokenCompiler (context assembly); ModelRouter (provider selection)
new_capabilities: Context assembly — gather relevant memories, knowledge graph nodes, past decisions, preferences
Multi-step reasoning — chain-of-thought with intermediate conclusions tracked as evidence
Uncertainty quantification — explicit confidence scores on every inference
Alternative generation — produce and rank multiple reasoning paths
Bias detection — identify when reasoning relies on low-confidence or stale memories
Reasoning trace — full audit trail of reasoning steps tied to evidence

interface.api: ReasoningKernelAPI: reason(), assemble_context(), quantify_uncertainty(), generate_alternatives(), audit_trace()

6_reasoning_kernel.integration: Sits between context assembly (MissionCompiler) and execution (Runtime). Does NOT modify the runtime pipeline — enriches the context that feeds into it.
6_reasoning_kernel.data_flow: MissionContext → ContextAssembler (KG + DecisionMemory + PreferenceModel) → ReasoningEngine → ReasoningResult → Runtime (as enriched context)

7_self_reflection_loop.name: Self Reflection Loop
7_self_reflection_loop.description: Periodic meta-cognitive cycle: evaluate recent performance → identify patterns → update memory → improve capabilities. The brain's learning mechanism.
new_capabilities: Performance review — aggregate mission evaluations over time window
Gap identification — detect capability gaps (missing knowledge, weak patterns, frequent failures)
Improvement proposal — generate PATCH/SKILL_IMPROVEMENT memory records
Hypothesis testing — propose improvement → test on next mission → evaluate → confirm/reject
Reflection journal — structured log of all reflection cycles with before/after metrics
Adaptive frequency — reflect more often when performance degrades, less when stable

interface.api: SelfReflectionAPI: reflect(), identify_gaps(), propose_improvement(), test_hypothesis(), journal()

7_self_reflection_loop.integration: Triggered after every N missions or on performance degradation. Reads from EvaluationEngine + ExperienceMemory + CapabilityRegistry. Writes to MemoryBrain + CapabilityRegistry.
7_self_reflection_loop.data_flow: EvaluationBatch → GapAnalyzer → ImprovementProposer → MemoryBrain (PATCH/SKILL_IMPROVEMENT) → HypothesisTracker → NextMission → Verify → Confirm/Reject

8_personal_preference_model.name: Personal Preference Model
8_personal_preference_model.description: Distills the owner's preferences from interaction history — explicit preferences, implicit patterns, and inferred priorities. Personalizes all brain outputs.
8_personal_preference_model.existing_foundation: MemoryKind.PREFERENCE + USER_FACT records, interaction history in memory
new_capabilities: Preference extraction — parse explicit 'I prefer X over Y' statements
Implicit preference inference — detect preferences from repeated choices/patterns
Preference weighting — confidence-weighted preference with decay for old preferences
Conflict resolution — detect contradictory preferences, flag for human clarification
Preference application — bias reasoning, ranking, and recommendations toward owner preferences
Preference evolution — track how preferences change over time

interface.api: PreferenceModelAPI: extract_preferences(), infer_implicit(), resolve_conflicts(), apply_bias(), track_evolution()

8_personal_preference_model.integration: Reads from MemoryBrain PREFERENCE + USER_FACT + DECISION records. Feeds into ReasoningKernel (bias application) and MissionIntelligence (personalization).

9_mission_intelligence_layer.name: Mission Intelligence Layer
9_mission_intelligence_layer.description: Mission-aware intelligence that enriches mission planning and execution with personal context: what the owner cares about, what worked before, what to avoid.
new_capabilities: Mission understanding — classify mission intent, domain, risk, complexity
Context enrichment — attach relevant knowledge graph nodes + past decisions + preferences
Strategy recommendation — suggest execution strategy based on mission similarity
Risk prediction — predict risk based on mission type + past failures + capability gaps
Resource estimation — estimate tokens, time, tools needed based on similar past missions
Post-mission analysis — compare predicted vs actual, feed back to all components

interface.api: MissionIntelligenceAPI: understand_mission(), enrich_context(), recommend_strategy(), predict_risk(), post_analyze()

9_mission_intelligence_layer.integration: Sits between mission triage and execution planning. Reads from ReasoningKernel + PreferenceModel + DecisionMemory + ExperienceMemory. Enriches MissionCompiler input.
9_mission_intelligence_layer.data_flow: MissionIntent → MissionIntelligence → EnrichedContext → MissionCompiler → Runtime → PostAnalysis → Feedback → All brain components

10_evolution_mechanism.name: Evolution Mechanism
10_evolution_mechanism.description: Long-term growth engine: recognizes patterns across the entire brain, proposes new capabilities, auto-registers proven skills, and tracks the brain's maturity.
new_capabilities: Pattern emergence detection — identify when enough experience exists to formalize a new skill
Capability proposal — propose new Capability entries based on proven patterns
Skill formalization — convert SKILL_IMPROVEMENT memories into registered Capabilities
Maturity tracking — brain maturity score across all 10 components
Evolution journal — structured log of all evolutionary steps with evidence
Evolution governance — human approval gate for new capability activation

interface.api: EvolutionAPI: detect_patterns(), propose_capability(), formalize_skill(), maturity_score(), approve_evolution()

10_evolution_mechanism.integration: Reads from all 9 other components. Writes to CapabilityRegistry (new capabilities) and MemoryBrain (EVOLUTION kind). Requires human approval per NSEC Article 37.
10_evolution_mechanism.data_flow: AllBrainComponents → PatternDetector → CapabilityProposer → HumanApproval → CapabilityRegistry + MemoryBrain → MaturityTracker

component_interaction_matrix.description: How each component interacts with every other component. R=Reads from, W=Writes to, B=Both.

runtime_integration_boundary.description: The Brain layer integrates with the existing runtime at specific hook points. ZERO runtime code modification.

hook_points.brain_action: MissionIntelligence: enrich mission context before admission
hook_points.integration_type: Pre-processing — brain enriches input, runtime executes as-is

hook_points.brain_action: ReasoningKernel + KnowledgeGraph: expand context with relevant knowledge
hook_points.integration_type: Enrichment — brain appends context, runtime uses enriched context

hook_points.brain_action: DecisionMemory + PreferenceModel: inform provider selection with past decisions
ExperienceMemory: compare current result against past similar results
hook_points.integration_type: Post-processing — brain reads runtime output, enriches verification

hook_points.brain_action: All components: write brain-specific evidence annotations
hook_points.integration_type: Parallel write — brain writes alongside runtime, no interference

hook_points.brain_action: SelfReflection + Evolution: propose improvements based on mission outcome
hook_points.integration_type: Augmentation — brain proposes additional patches, runtime processes them

hook_points.brain_action: SelfReflection: trigger reflection if performance degraded; Evolution: check for emergent patterns
hook_points.integration_type: Post-processing — brain reads evaluation, triggers meta-cognition

brain_state_store.description: Brain-specific state stored alongside (not inside) existing runtime storage.
tables: brain_component_status — activation state, last run, health per component
knowledge_graph_nodes — entity nodes with type, confidence, provenance
decision_records — structured decisions with context, alternatives, outcome
experience_records — distilled lessons from mission outcomes
preference_weights — per-domain preference scores with confidence
evolution_journal — capability emergence and formalization log
reasoning_traces — audit trail of reasoning steps
mission_intelligence_cache — enriched context snapshots per mission
brain_maturity_scores — component-level and aggregate maturity metrics

memory_integration.description: Brain components write enriched records through MemoryBrain → MemoryKernel. The existing memory.py is the single write path.
new_memory_kinds_proposed: EVOLUTION — capability emergence and formalization records
REASONING_TRACE — reasoning step audit trail (supplementary, not primary)

activation_phases.description: Components are activated progressively. Each phase builds on the memory foundation of prior phases.

phase_1_foundation.description: Establish unified memory fabric with consolidation, decay, and ranking.

phase_2_knowledge.prerequisite: Phase 1 complete + sufficient semantic memories accumulated
phase_2_knowledge.description: Build structured knowledge from memory content. Record decisions systematically.

phase_3_cognition.prerequisite: Phase 2 complete + sufficient decision records for pattern mining
phase_3_cognition.description: Enable active reasoning over knowledge. Learn from mission experiences.

phase_4_meta.prerequisite: Phase 3 complete + sufficient mission history for reflection
phase_4_meta.description: Add self-improvement, personalization, and mission-aware intelligence.

phase_5_evolution.prerequisite: Phase 4 complete + proven patterns emerging across components
phase_5_evolution.description: Enable long-term autonomous growth with human governance approval.

absolute_prohibition: Bypass MemoryKernel for direct SQLite writes
Implement any brain component before architecture review approval
Register new Capabilities without human approval (NSEC Article 37)
allowed_actions: Create new files under src/nexara_prime/brain/ (new package, additive only)
Create new test files under tests/brain/
Read from existing runtime components (read-only integration)

governance_gates.architecture_freeze: IN_EFFECT — no implementation until review passes
